BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD COLUMN staging_receipt_json jsonb;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_status;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_status CHECK(status IN ('PROPOSED','CONFIRMED','AUTHORING','READY','STAGED','PUBLISHED','FAILED'));
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_tz_status;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_tz_status CHECK(tz_job_status IS NULL OR tz_job_status IN ('PLANNED','GENERATING','VERIFYING','READY','STAGED','FAILED'));
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow DROP CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_state_shape;
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_state_shape CHECK(
 status='FAILED'
 OR (status='PROPOSED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
 OR (status='CONFIRMED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
 OR (status='AUTHORING' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
 OR (status='READY' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
 OR (status='STAGED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND tz_job_status='STAGED' AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND staging_receipt_json IS NOT NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
 OR (status='PUBLISHED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL)
);
ALTER TABLE project_authoring_flow ADD CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_staging_receipt CHECK(staging_receipt_json IS NULL OR COALESCE(
 jsonb_typeof(staging_receipt_json)='object'
 AND staging_receipt_json->>'schema'='practice-task-staging-receipt.v1'
 AND staging_receipt_json->>'state'='staged'
 AND staging_receipt_json->>'authoring_job_id'=tz_authoring_job_id::text
 AND staging_receipt_json->>'candidate_digest'=ready_candidate_digest
 AND staging_receipt_json->>'blueprint_digest'=ready_blueprint_digest
 AND staging_receipt_json->>'staged_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
 AND length(staging_receipt_json->>'family_key') BETWEEN 1 AND 128
 AND length(staging_receipt_json->>'variant_key') BETWEEN 1 AND 128
 AND length(staging_receipt_json->>'created_at') > 0,
 false));
CREATE FUNCTION reject_project_authoring_staging_mutation() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.staging_receipt_json IS NOT NULL AND NEW.staging_receipt_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.staging_receipt_json THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'project staging receipt is immutable';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_authoring_staging_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON project_authoring_flow FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_project_authoring_staging_mutation();
COMMIT;
